name: HyperCross
storyline:
HyperCross is a futuristic motocross racer set in a neon-scarred city under a burning red sky. Ride six bikes, from a screaming 125 2T to the electric Jolt Ripper, across 18 circuits, and race the ghosts of the best riders on the global leaderboard.

Storyline
After the Grid Collapse, the great towers of the old megacity were abandoned to the red storm clouds and the toxic green haze creeping up from the lower districts. The sky never cleared, but the engines never stopped.

In the ruins, riders turned the skyways, elevated ring roads and dirt-churned wastelands into a brutal underground circuit: HyperCross. There are no sponsors and no safety nets, only mud, whoops, long jumps and the roar of two-strokes against the hum of the new electric machines. Every circuit is carved from the city’s remains, and every one can be ridden forward or in reverse, because in the Cross the track is never the same twice.

You arrive with nothing but a 125 and a helmet with a cyan visor. Each win unlocks more power, from the 250s to the 500 2T and the 450 4T. At the top of the ladder waits the Jolt Ripper, an electric beast built to leave everything else behind.

Standing in your way is the Duel rival, a rider who never changes bikes: the Reaper. Beating him on a lesser machine is a legend in the making. Beating him on the best is how you earn your name on the leaderboard, and the right to race its ghosts.
